subject: Invoice split & collection runbook request — ArborCloud (multi-entity)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ArborCloud AP <ap@arborcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: how to issue one bill split across ArborCloud legal entities

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — we have a billing requirement on our side and wanted to check the best approach with Redwood. ArborCloud is organized as three legal entities and we need charges for the Redwood subscription to be allocable to each entity for tax and GL purposes. The entities and high-level preferences are below:

- ArborCloud US, Inc. (EIN/Tax ID: 12-3456789) — prefers USD and ACH payment to US bank
- ArborCloud EU B.V. (VAT ID: NL999999999B01) — prefers EUR settlement (SEPA) and needs VAT-referenced invoice lines
- ArborCloud APAC Pte Ltd (GST Reg: 2027-AP-4432) — prefers SGD or USD per our treasury team

We need to do one monthly statement for the consolidated account, but the actual invoice and tax treatment should allow our AP teams to pay/record to their respective ledgers. Options we can accept:

1) Three separate invoices each billed to the correct legal entity (simplest for tax & reconciliation), or
2) One consolidated invoice with clear line-level allocations and legal-entity tags and separate remittance instructions per entity (preferred by our procurement if Redwood can support programmatic payment routing).

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you issue per-entity invoices or a single invoice with entity-level cost-center mapping?
- Will Redwood include VAT/Tax amounts per line for EU entity?
- Do you have a standard excel/template we can use to map cost centers/NetSuite classes to invoice lines?
- Is it possible to receive separate PDF invoices + a consolidated statement for our treasury?

I attached a short note from our AP team that lists internal PO requirements and bank details. Can your finance team confirm the recommended route and any contract amendment (if needed) to add multiple remit-to instructions?

Thanks — we’d like to resolve this ahead of our renewal next month.

— Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations, ArborCloud
Lena.Oritz@arborcloud.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborcloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: how to issue one bill split across ArborCloud legal entities

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear summary and the AP note. Looping in our Finance (Karthik) and Sales ops (Ben) and Legal/Accounting (Marissa) to finalize an approach.

High-level plan from Redwood: 3 practical options (we’ll deliver a sample for each so you can pick):

A) Issue three separate invoices each tied to the legal entity (recommended for tax clarity).
   - Each invoice shows the line items and tax/VAT where applicable.
   - Easy for NetSuite mapping and local AP processing.

B) Single consolidated invoice + separate PDF invoice-per-entity (one consolidated statement plus three remit-able invoices).
   - Conserves documentation for your procurement while keeping per-entity remittance.

C) Single invoice with line-level entity tags and a downloadable split matrix CSV for automated ingest.
   - Best if you want to post a single invoice and allocate programmatically. This requires your ERP to consume our mapping fields.

To proceed, please confirm the following by EOD Friday so we can produce sample docs:
- Which option (A/B/C) you prefer
- Confirm VAT IDs, PO numbers (if already available), and preferred currencies per entity
- Any required invoice memo format (e.g., cost-center codes or project IDs) for NetSuite

I’ve attached our split_matrix_skeleton.xlsx — it contains columns for invoice_line_id, amount, entity_tag, VAT_rate, GL_class, cost_center_code. Karthik, can you review and flag anything else we should include for EU VAT compliance and cross-border withholding?

We’ll also surface if a contract amendment is required (Marissa), but most customers have handled this operationally without a formal SOW change.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: how to issue one bill split across ArborCloud legal entities

Thanks — quick finance POV. I think Option A (three invoices) will be the cleanest from a VAT and withholding standpoint, especially because ArborCloud has a VAT-registered EU entity. Notes below:

- EU VAT: If we invoice the EU entity (ArborCloud EU B.V.) in EUR and include VAT where required, their AP can reclaim where applicable. Consolidating into one invoice with mixed tax treatments can create reconciliation friction.
- Currency: We can issue in different currencies but our billing system will need to pick a functional currency per invoice; exchange-rate variance will need to be managed on your side if you prefer a single settlement currency.
- Remittance: For cross-entity payments, best practice is to provide separate PDF invoices with distinct remit-to instructions (bank account or wire details) per entity. We can also provide intermediary memos with NetSuite class codes to aid automated matching.
- GL mapping: The split_matrix has the right fields. Please add "ns_class_id" and "ns_segment" columns to match your NetSuite import template.
- Tax IDs: Please provide the full VAT/Tax IDs exactly as they should appear on the invoice.

Action items for us (internal):
- Soojin/Bob: produce sample PDFs for Option A and Option B (I will review tax numbers).
- Ben: confirm whether account-level discounts or credits need to be apportioned pro rata across entities (I assume yes; please confirm).
- Marissa: check if we need a short amendment to the MSA to add multiple remit-to instructions.

One more practical note: if ArborCloud prefers a single payment to one Redwood bank account and then an internal allocation, that is also doable but it leaves ArborCloud with reconciliation work. Issuing three invoices minimizes that burden.

Karthik
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborcloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 17:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: how to issue one bill split across ArborCloud legal entities — next steps

Hi Lena — thanks for the quick responses earlier this week. Confirming next steps and timeline so your AP can plan: 

1) Timberline (our billing ops) will produce three candidate approaches and sample PDFs by Monday, 03 May 2027:
   - Sample A: three separate invoices (one per legal entity) — recommended for immediate rollout
   - Sample B: consolidated statement + per-entity PDFs (if you prefer a single consolidated doc for procurement)
   - Sample C: single invoice + machine-readable split CSV (for ERP ingestion)

2) We need the following from ArborCloud by COB Friday, 07 May 2027 to keep the May billing cycle:
   - Confirm which option you want to test (A/B/C)
   - Provide final VAT/Tax IDs (as they should appear on invoice) and any PO numbers
   - Provide your NetSuite import template or confirm the split_matrix column names (we already suggested ns_class_id and ns_segment)

3) If you select Option A or B, we will not require a contract amendment in most cases. If Option C requires structural metadata to be appended to invoice PDFs, Marissa will confirm whether a short amendment is helpful.

Attachments: redwood_split_matrix_skeleton.xlsx (we filled sample line items), proposed_amendment-invoice-routing.docx (draft wording for multiple remit-to). DocuSign link included if you want to sign amendment online.

Please reply with preferred option and the VAT/Tax IDs. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call next week to walk the AP team through the files.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this operational before renewal.

Best,
Soojin
Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
